name: Audience grid with a dropping percentage
description: A spaced mono label and a big accent percentage over a grid of little person icons (10 x 8 by default) on the clean dotted background. The percentage counts from the start value to the final one while icons fade to light grey in a scattered order until only that share is left; the few survivors turn accent.
use_when: Lines about how many people see, stay, click or care: reach shrinking, most viewers leaving, only a few percent of an audience, a share of people who do something.

kicker.help: small spaced label above the number

to.help: final percentage (0-100); lower than 'from' fades icons out, higher lights them up
